takeaway: Gemini Robotics answers in about 250 ms yet controls at 50 Hz because each answer carries a chunk of actions; 13 or more cover the wait, fewer leave the arm idle.
sentence: Sending at least 13 actions in each reply keeps the robot working while it waits for the next reply.
reason: Both say that replies carrying at least 13 actions keep the robot working through the wait for the next reply.
